HotDocsConditionalLogic.Description: Complex conditional logic patterns used in legal document automation

ConditionalExample.Name: Client Type Variation
ConditionalExample.Scenario: Include different sections based on whether client is individual or business

IF.Paragraph: WHEREAS, [[ClientFirstName]] [[ClientLastName]], an individual ("Client"), desires to engage the services of the Firm;
Client shall sign this agreement as an individual.

ELSEIF.Paragraph: WHEREAS, [[ClientBusinessName]], a [[StateOfIncorporation]] [[EntityType]] ("Client"), desires to engage the services of the Firm;
Client shall be represented by [[AuthorizedRepresentative]], with authority to bind the Client.

ELSE.Paragraph: WHEREAS, [[ClientBusinessName]], a [[StateOfFormation]] [[EntityType]], by and through its partners, desires to engage the services of the Firm;

ConditionalExample.Name: Contingency Fee Structure
ConditionalExample.Scenario: Different fee terms based on whether engagement is contingency or hourly

IF.Paragraph: The Firm shall receive [[ContingencyPercentage]]% of any recovery obtained through settlement, judgment, or award.

ELSEIF.Paragraph: The Firm shall receive a fixed fee of [[ContingencyFixedAmount]] upon successful resolution of the matter.

Section.Name: HourlyFeeSection
Section.Paragraph: The Firm's hourly rate is [[HourlyRate]]. A retainer of [[HourlyRetainer]] is required upon engagement.

ConditionalExample.Name: Jurisdiction-Specific Terms
ConditionalExample.Scenario: Include different legal provisions based on jurisdiction

IF.Paragraph: Pursuant to California State Bar Rules of Professional Conduct, the following fee provisions apply: [CA-specific terms]

ELSEIF.Paragraph: In accordance with the Texas Disciplinary Rules of Professional Conduct, the following terms are applicable: [TX-specific terms]
Under the New York Rules of Professional Conduct, the following provisions shall apply: [NY-specific terms]

ELSE.Paragraph: This matter is governed by applicable federal law and the rules of the jurisdictions in which the parties are located.

ConditionalExample.Name: Complex Nested Logic
ConditionalExample.Scenario: Multiple levels of conditional logic for complex decision trees

IF.Paragraph: This international transaction exceeding $1,000,000 requires specialized review including currency and tax considerations.

ELSE.Paragraph: This international transaction involves standard cross-border documentation and compliance review.
This domestic transaction will follow standard procedures.
